findings_qualitative.value: Linewidths 3-6 km/s for GC clouds, 3.5-5 km/s for Scutum cloud

claims.hypothesis: COMs exist in Galactic diffuse clouds
claims.experiment: Search for absorption toward K4 in EMoCA data
claims.result: CH3OH, CH3CN, CH3CHO, HC3N, NH2CHO in GC clouds; CH3OH, CH3CN in Scutum arm
claims.finding: COMs are present in diffuse clouds

evidence.quote: We report the detection of the (complex) organic molecules CH$_3$OH, CH$_3$CN, CH$_3$CHO, HC$_3$N, and NH$_2$CHO in diffuse GC clouds

claims.hypothesis: Diffuse GC cloud chemistry resembles z=0.89 absorber

evidence.quote: Apart from HC$_3$N, the chemical composition relative to methanol of the 3.4 km s$^{-1}$ GC diffuse cloud is similar to the one of the $z=0.89$ spiral galaxy.

why_this_data.value: K4 is strong continuum source away from hot cores, giving absorption sensitivity along the whole line of sight

evidence.quote: The ultracompact H ii region K4 (cite: gaume1995) fulfills these requirements.

limitations_admitted.value: Methanol abundances may be overestimated because H2 may be underestimated due to clumpiness and coarse HF resolution

evidence.quote: it may be that the abundances we obtain are overestimated due to an underestimate of the H$_2$ column density

referee_caveats_inferred: Absorption toward a single position; beam filling factor assumed 1
No uncertainties for most column densities
Tex assumed CMB for many species
H2 from 40" data mismatched with 1.6" ALMA
